items: Full Form: National Action for Mechanized Sanitation Ecosystem
Ministries Involved: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & Ministry of Social Justice and
100% mechanized cleaning of sewers and septic tanks.
Formalization, skilling, and empowerment of sanitation workers.
Insurance coverage under Ayushman Bharat for sanitation workers.
Provides training and mechanized equipment for safe cleaning.
Promotes alternative livelihoods and worker rehabilitation.
Develops a sanitation worker database for effective monitoring.
Focus: Eliminate manual scavenging, ensure worker safety, and promote mechanized sanitation
